verified_sources.source_name: Caparol Arabia & San Marco Architectural Facades Comparison Manual
verified_sources.key_insights: Technical breakdown of Standard Acrylic Sigma (Styrene Acrylic) vs Italian Siloxane/Silicone Sigma (Polysiloxane) vs Granite Plaster (Coloured Quartz Chips in Clear Acrylic Matrix). Crack-bridging capability, water vapor permeability (Sd value), and dirt pick-up resistance.

Longevity data across Kuwait climates (Coastal Salmiya/Fintas vs Desert Mutlaa/Jahra): Standard Sigma averages 6-8 years before chalking/fading, Italian Siloxane averages 12-15 years, Granite finishes average 10-14 years. Salt and dust accumulation profiles.

verified_sources.source_name: Shuwaikh Industrial Building Facade Pricing Ledger 2026
verified_sources.key_insights: Turnkey material + labor pricing per square meter: Standard Sigma (4.000 - 5.000 KWD/sqm), Italian Siloxane Sigma (5.500 - 7.500 KWD/sqm), Spray Granite / Marble Chip Finish (6.500 - 9.000 KWD/sqm).
